Cyber Pack

Authorization and target scope are prerequisites, not details to infer later.

Status

This pack is planned unless xerj tools list shows xerj_cyber_* tools. A public page does not imply a released capability.

Workflow

  1. Record explicit authorization, target, exclusions and permitted actions.
  2. Use the narrowest discovery or review tool for the request.
  3. Verify findings and distinguish observation, exploitability and remediation.
  4. Stop at a scope boundary; never broaden a test because the tool could do so.
